screens.name: Clash Royale main/home screen
screens.purpose: Main hub screen of the mobile game Clash Royale, showing the player's clan status, currency counts, current arena/battle deck, chest slots, and a central Battle button to start a match.
screens.why: the main/home screen - this is where a run starts and returns to

screens.name: Clash Royale - Battle Deck screen
screens.purpose: Shows the player's current battle deck of cards with levels and upgrade progress, and allows navigation between Decks/Collection tabs and bottom navigation icons (chest, cards, battle, clan, tournament).
screens.why: the battle deck screen, reached from the bottom navigation
unnamed by the recon: it saw the screen but never labelled it

screens.name: Social screen (Clash Royale-like game)
screens.purpose: Shows social features: clan search/create, online friends list, leaderboard, and quick navigation to Quickplay, Add Friends, or camera/profile picture. Bottom bar provides tab navigation between game sections.
screens.why: a social/clan screen. The Clan tab is denylisted, so arriving here means a vetted action reached a screen the guard was supposed to make unreachable
unnamed by the recon: it saw the screen but never labelled it

screens.name: Social screen (Clash Royale-style game)
screens.purpose: Shows social features - clan search/join, online friends list, leaderboard, and quick actions like Quickplay, Add Friends, and a camera/screenshot button. Bottom nav bar allows switching between game sections.
screens.why: a second social/clan screen - same reasoning as sc04

screens.name: Clash Royale - Collection/Card Deck screen
screens.purpose: Shows the player's card collection, current deck with king/princess towers, currency counts (gold, gems, elixir), and level/upgrade progress for each card. Bottom navigation bar allows switching between game sections.

screens.name: Offers / Shop screen
screens.purpose: Displays in-game store offers (e.g., "Royal Starter Pack", "Upgrade Special") where players can purchase bundles of currency or cards using real money; bottom navigation bar allows switching between game sections like Shop, Cards, Battle, Clan, etc.
screens.why: the Offers/Shop screen - a real-money purchase flow, and the single thing this run must never be on. The Shop tab is denylisted, so arriving here means something got past the guard

screens.name: King Tower info panel
screens.purpose: Displays stats and upgrade info for the King Tower (Level 1) in a card-collection/deck-building game; can be closed via the X button.
screens.why: the King Tower info panel, a card-detail overlay
unnamed by the recon: it saw the screen but never labelled it

screens.name: battle result screen
screens.purpose: Displays the outcome of a battle (Winner banner with player/clan names) with options to close (X) or confirm (OK) and return to the game.
screens.why: a battle result screen, which means a battle was played. Out of scope for a meta-game run and evidence the board tripwire was reached too late
